transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Um... I guess I'm here because... well, for almost two years now, I've just had this... certainty about things at work. After a commission I did, a few people in the ensemble started... quietly undermining my work. Just using things like schedule changes, or seating choices... little comments during rehearsals. They always show me emails or notes that supposedly explain it all, but... I just can't shake it.
Have you ever considered that this might not be true?

I mean... I try to. Like I just said, they always have those emails or notes ready to explain away the schedule changes or the seating arrangements. And I look at them. I do. 

But... no. It doesn't change anything. I just... I know they're undermining me. I can't really explain the certainty, I just... I can't shake it.
Have you ever heard voices when no one else was around?
Do you believe anyone is trying to harm you?
Harm me? Um... no. Not physically or anything. Just... what I already said. With my work.
Do you think there is any chance at all that you might be mistaken about this?

I... no. Like I said, I just can't shake it. It's been almost two years now, ever since that commission. I just know a few people in the ensemble are doing this. The schedule stuff, the seating, the little comments they make in rehearsals... it's all to quietly undermine my work. So... no. I don't think I'm mistaken.
